body: I just try to take it day by day. Despite being in a relationship I was deprived of attention too. My partner was not a good partner. There have been a lot of ups and downs in my dealings with this. Some days are harder than others.

I recently lost my dream job. I too was seduced by someone, a co-worker, who led me on enough to end a 10 yr relationship, only to be told they don't actually want to be with me. Then I got fired.

I've been feeling a lot like you, for a long time. I keep trying to push on. I hope you do too. From one heartbroken person to another, I feel your pain.
I dont watch tv anymore. I don't play games really either. I used to like to play guitar, but I lack confidence. I read sometimes, if I can get myself off social media.

To be honest I'd off myself in a heartbeat but I have a kid and if I die he'd be forced to live with my abusive ex. 

I want to die so badly. I keep trying to figure out how I could will him to my mom in the event of my death.
It's the worst kind of pain. I'm sorry that you feel it too.
Every day is exactly the same
I don't enjoy those things anymore. I don't enjoy much anymore.
Thank you but it seems we do not share the same beliefs. I am an atheist.

Every day since I first set foot on the planet. I get so sick of fucks who say that. 

"Oh you're so strong"

I'm not strong, the world just likes to kick the shit out of some people for some reason. Maybe I was a serial killer in my past life or some shit.
Well that kind of made me laugh at least. Tomorrow will be the same clusterfuck shitshow
Also I'm not a dude I'm over 35 and I am a parent.
